proof.text: Evaluate the assumed termwise tilde comparison hcomp on the single complex with the free rank-one A-module in degree zero. By DerivedCategory.Q_obj_single_obj, its source is the image under e.functor followed by the full-subcategory inclusion of the degree-zero derived object. No construction of the equivalence is needed, since e and hcomp are hypotheses.

Compose this component with DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso of HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex for tilde, and then with DerivedCategory.singleFunctor.mapIso of AlgebraicGeometry.tildeSelf. These give an isomorphism from the image of A in degree zero to the structure sheaf in degree zero. The explicit local PreservesZeroMorphisms instance is built from tilde.map_zero, as in the statement of hcomp.

Extract the CommShift structure from htri. For each integer k, compose its commShiftIso component at the degree-zero object with shiftFunctor.mapIso applied to the degree-zero isomorphism. This proves the required Nonempty isomorphism for every k; the IsTriangulated proof is not needed.

title: Affine equivalence preserves shifts of the unit
statement: For an equivalence e equipped with the termwise tilde comparison and compatible triangulated structure, every integer shift of the free rank-one A-module is sent to the corresponding shift of the structure sheaf.

lean.statement:
theorem affineQCohDerivedEquivalence_shift (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    (e : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ≌ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (hcomp : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ e.functor ⋙
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι ≅
        @Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
          (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
            SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
            (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Q))
    (htri : ∃ (_h : (e.functor ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι).CommShift ℤ),
        (e.functor ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι).IsTriangulated) :
      ∀ k : ℤ, Nonempty
        ((e.functor ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι).obj
          (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
            (ModuleCat.of A A))⟦k⟧) ≅
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)))⟦k⟧)
